question: After preserving actual attention-forward saved tensors improves fixed-point gradients, does the same intervention preserve actual zero-state AdamW first-step parameter updates against dense updates?

config.optimizer_context: zero-state first step only; all parameters including bias/norm share one group

baseline_rule: Same-runtime gradient method fields including all76 per-parameter statistics and gradient hashes must equal the frozen attention diagnostic. A different platform must supply a same-runtime replay of that existing protocol; no cross-platform exact hash claim.
batch_selection: batch_schedule(8,24,2,seed)[0]; same first batches as previous loss-boundary diagnostic; overlapping examples,320 unique target positions across three batches
scope: One predeclared experiment,3workers,3policies,9fixed-point backwards and9actual torch.optim.AdamW steps on detached full-parameter clones. The original model never updates. No stateful/history context in this experiment.
numpy_reference: Independent float64 equations: m1=beta1*m0+(1-beta1)*g;v1=beta2*v0+(1-beta2)*g^2;t1=t0+1;mhat=m1/(1-beta1^t1);vhat=v1/(1-beta2^t1);theta1=theta0*(1-lr*weight_decay)-lr*mhat/(sqrt(vhat)+epsilon). Zero m/v and step0, cloned identically per arm. Validate native theta1,m1,v1 and step against NumPy, accounting explicitly for float32 operation rounding.
reference_tolerance: Every element finite. For theta: abs(native-reference64)<=8*eps32*(abs(theta0)+abs(reference64-theta0))+8*tiny32. For m/v: abs(native-reference64)<=8*eps32*abs(reference64)+8*tiny32. No relative-to-weight metric substitutes for update fidelity.
controls: Exact unchanged model parameter hash before/after each backward and optimizer clone step; all clone/gradient/state storages disjoint from original model.
All76 finite gradient tensors/14067712elements; same logits/loss and analytic CE relativeL2<=1e-5; exact13LayerNorm and actual6attention coverage inherited unchanged.
Every arm clones identical initial parameters and zero m/v/step0; native optimizer step is1; full theta/m/v/delta hashes retained.
Dense and both compressed gradients exactly match each corresponding frozen attention method record in the same runtime.

Independent NumPy tiny mixed-sign/zero/tiny/large-gradient control detects wrong epsilon placement and coupled decay; grad=None skips parameter/state while explicit zero gradient applies decoupled decay and increments step.
Actual float32 delta=theta_after-theta_before; every one of76 parameters contributes to aggregate squared norms,dot products,max error and cosine. Raw weights-relative error is descriptive only.
gate: All3batches: treatment actual update relativeL2<=0.10,cosine>=0.99,and treatment/norm-only update relativeL2<=0.5 with cosine no worse. Zero/undefined/nonfinite denominator,nonfinite ratio or incomplete controls cannot pass. A valid scientific gate failure is retained as a completed result; controls failure is invalid/incomplete. No tuning or extra candidate after results.
execution: Sequential3fresh workers,180second comparison-loop cap after model loading,300second parent cap. Fixed method order. Reuse fixed gradients only within their own worker optimizer comparison; no extra training forward,holdout,scheduler,clipping,stateful trajectory or second experiment.
implementation_freeze: The new experiment and test source hashes are recorded after implementation and before tests/model execution in an ignored implementation-freeze receipt; dependency hashes above are already frozen. Parent receives protocol hashes before implementation begins.
limitations: First-step AdamW is strongly sign/epsilon sensitive; a gradient-relativeL2 improvement need not preserve update direction.
